SerpstatApiTokenCredential.title: Serpstat API Token
SerpstatApiTokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing personal Serpstat API token. Current v4 requires query parameter token; native transport logs are protected. No environment fallback, token generation, OAuth or sandbox. Current API access starts at Team; actual credits, delays and API plugin access come from the protected account limits read. SEO/result calls can consume live credits even for empty responses; connection uses documented non-credit getStats. Account proof does not prove rank/audit access or a free entitlement.
